market_reading_one_paragraph: The 5 Nov tape can carry a growth scare and an oil rebound at the same time, and it does not identify one cause. Nasdaq, Dow, and Russell fell hard on 2026-11-05 while WTI and Brent rebounded inside or beside ordinary daily percent variation and remained well below their 30 Oct closes; copper fell with the equity complex. US front-end yields rallied that day and the 10y breakeven eased, which is a growth-or-policy price response rather than an inflation spike, but S&P, VIX, HY OAS, Canada yields, and the real 10y stop on 2026-11-04, and broad USD stops on 2026-10-30, so the credit stress in the news is not yet the HY series. Canada’s priced 2027 CORRA path still steps up from a 2.52 benchmark, with the back of the owned strip the open disagreement. EURUSD gave back part of the 4 Nov rise on an ordinary down day. No euro-specific residual has appeared since the override that opened the long.
